{"parentUuid":"507c244d-bd62-449c-b934-221af436942d","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"a565c064bdc539ddd","attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- framer-motion-animator: Creates smooth animations and micro-interactions using Framer Motion including page transitions, gestures, scroll-based animations, and orchestrated sequences. Use when users request \"add animation\", \"framer motion\", \"page transition\", \"animate component\", or \"micro-interactions\".\n- vercel-react-best-practices: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, Next.js pages, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.\n- writing-backend-code: Use when writing, extending or reviewing backend code in packages/backend — new modules, routes, services, repositories, migrations, auth checks, config, errors, email, tests, or server lifecycle.\n- writing-frontend-code: Use when writing, extending or reviewing frontend code in packages/frontend — pages, components, hooks, react-query data fetching, dialogs/forms, routing, styling, or performance. House conventions are paired with React performance rules (adapted from Vercel Engineering) scoped to this client-rendered React Query SPA.\n- design: Create a design canvas - a multi-artboard visual design published as an Artifact that runs Claude Design's canvas editor (an early preview of Claude Design inside Claude Code). You DRAFT the design as .dc.html artboards laid out on one pan/zoom canvas; where saving is enabled for the user's account they refine every element visually (click-to-select, a properties panel, inline text editing, undo/redo) and Save publishes a new version for everyone, otherwise they get a view-and-export (PNG/PDF) preview of your draft. Good for UI mockups and screen flows, landing pages, marketing and social graphics, and print pieces - posters, flyers, brochures as single-page artboards; memos and reports as one flowing artboard. Use when someone wants a design, mockup, wireframe, UI or screen design, landing page, poster, flyer, brochure, banner, card, one-pager, or any visual layout they would rather tweak by hand than in code. Only for CREATING or re-seeding a canvas; an existing one is edited in its published Artifact.\n- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: \"chart\", \"graph\", \"plot\", \"data viz\", \"visualization\", \"dashboard\", \"analytics\", \"visualize data\", \"categorical colors\", \"sequential / diverging palette\", \"stat tile\", \"sparkline\", \"heatmap\", \"legend\", \"axis\", \"tooltip\", \"chart colors\", \"color by series\".\n- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts. - Load before writing any artifact, including a skill-instructed Markdown one - Markdown is never a shortcut past the design pass.\n- artifact-diagramming: Diagramming know-how for Artifacts - when a picture earns its place, how to draw one that shows the real mechanism, and the inline-SVG mechanics that keep it legible in both themes.\n- artifact-capabilities: Runtime capabilities a published Artifact page can be granted — behavior static HTML cannot provide on its own, such as the page reading live or connected data, remembering what people do on it (a poll, a sign-up sheet, a checklist, a document edited in place — it saves new versions of itself), keeping state shared across viewers, knowing who is viewing, asking Claude a question of its own, storing files people add, or handing the viewer a file to save. Serves this user's live capability roster and the typed call definitions. Load it whenever any such runtime behavior would make an artifact more useful, before writing the page.\n- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. For ultra on a GitHub.com PR target, --post asks to post the finished review’s findings to the PR as a single comment from the user’s GitHub account (not a review; the launch dialog still confirms in interactive sessions, while non-interactive mode posts on the flag alone) and --no-post hides that option.\n- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- eas-app-stores: EAS service (paid). Deploy Expo apps to the app stores with EAS - build and submit to the iOS App Store, Google Play Store, and TestFlight, configure eas.json build and submit profiles, manage app versions and build numbers, and publish App Store metadata and ASO. Use whenever the user wants to deploy, release, or ship an app to production or the app stores, is preparing a production build, running eas build or eas submit, shipping to TestFlight, bumping version or build numbers, or setting up store listing metadata. For deploying an Expo website or API routes, use the eas-hosting skill. (from packages/mobile/.claude/skills — applies when working on files under packages/mobile/)\n- eas-hosting: EAS service (paid). Deploy Expo websites and Expo Router API routes to EAS Hosting - export the web bundle, run eas deploy for production and PR preview URLs, manage environment secrets and custom domains, and work within the Cloudflare Workers runtime. Also covers authoring API routes (+api.ts handlers, HTTP methods, request handling, CORS). Use when deploying an Expo web app or API routes, setting up EAS Hosting, or configuring hosting environments and domains. Not for native builds or store releases - use the eas-app-stores skill for those. (from packages/mobile/.claude/skills — applies when working on files under packages/mobile/)\n- eas-observe: EAS service (paid). Use for anything related to EAS Observe - adding `expo-observe` to an Expo project (AppMetricsRoot/ObserveRoot HOC, markInteractive and ObserveInteractiveMarker, the useObserve hook, the Expo Router / React Navigation integrations for per-route metrics, user-defined events via `Observe.logEvent`, error reporting via ObserveErrorBoundary and `Observe.reportError`, and runtime config such as sampleRate and dispatchInDebug), querying via the EAS CLI (`eas observe:metrics-summary`, `observe:metrics`, `observe:routes`, `observe:events`, `observe:session`, `observe:versions`), interpreting the resulting metrics (cold/warm launch, TTR, TTI, navigation cold/warm TTR, update download, and the TTI frameRate/device/network params for triaging slow startups), or shipping an Observe integration inside a third-party package. (from packages/mobile/.claude/skills — applies when working on files under packages/mobile/)\n- eas-simulator: EAS service (paid). Run and control a user's app on a remote iOS/Android simulator hosted on EAS cloud. Read before running any `eas simulator:*` commands - it has the current syntax for this experimental API. Use whenever the user needs a simulator they can't run locally - 'run my app on a cloud simulator', 'use eas simulator to run/install/screenshot my app', 'I'm on Linux/Cursor and need an iOS device', 'no sim on this box / headless CI', 'let an agent click through my app and screenshot it', 'test my dev build on a remote sim with live reload', 'stream a sim to my browser' - even when they don't say 'EAS Simulator' or 'cloud'. On a host WITHOUT a local simulator (Linux, CI, cloud sandbox) it's the default; on macOS, do NOT auto-trigger for a plain 'run on the simulator' - use it only for a cloud/remote/shareable sim, an iOS version they lack, or an agent-driven session. NOT for local sims (expo run:ios, Xcode, Android Studio), EAS Build/Update, web preview, or physical devices. (from packages/mobile/.claude/skills — applies when working on files under packages/mobile/)\n- expo-animation: Framework (OSS). Build animations in React Native and Expo, making the decisions in the order that determines whether they feel right — should it animate, which thread it runs on, which properties, spring or timing, how the gesture hands off, how it degrades. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Toolbar pins it to `300px`.\n\n---\n\n## 4. LAYOUT RULES\n\n### 4.1 Vertical composition of a page\nThe page is a column with **`gap: 16px`** and **`padding-top: 24px`** supplied by `ContentContainer` (`ContentContainer/styles.tsx:19-29`); every child owns its own **24px** horizontal gutter. Canonical order (e.g. `features/finance/change-orders/index.tsx:283-310`):\n\n```\n[BreadcrumbBar]         padding 0 24px\n                   ↕ 16px\n[KPI card row]          padding 0 24px, flex row nowrap, gap 16px   ← change-orders/styles.tsx:8-13\n                   ↕ 16px\n[ErnestPageToolbar]     padding 0 24px; search+filters left / buttons right; internal gap 32px\n                   ↕ 16px\n[ErnestDataGrid]        full-bleed, own 24px first/last-cell padding, border-top 1px #EBEBF4\n```\n`ErnestDataGridWithSearchAndFilter` (`components/design-system/composed/ErnestDataGridWithSearchAndFilter/index.tsx:50-84`) is the one-call composition of toolbar + grid, with `frontButtons`/`backButtons` slots feeding the toolbar's right cluster.\n\nKPI card gaps vary slightly by page: `16px` on change-orders (`change-orders/styles.tsx:12`), `24px` on insights (`InsightsPageCards/styles.tsx:7`), `12px` between the switch row and card row on insights (`project-insights/styles.tsx:6`).\n\n### 4.2 Section headers & detail panels\nInside drawers/forms, a section is:\n```\nTypography h3.medium (24/32/500) #24242E          ← section title\n  …fields…\ncontainer: padding-bottom 40px; border-bottom 1px solid #CFCFE4; gap 24px\n```\n(`features/finance/change-orders/Form/Details.tsx:251-256`; `change-orders/styles.tsx` `useViewStyles.section`.)\n\n**Label/value pairs** — a two-column 38/62 split with an underline on the value, not a boxed table (`change-orders/styles.tsx` `useViewStyles`, and the same shape duplicated at `features/materials/requests/components/CommodityPage/styles.ts:93-121`):\n```\nfield:    flex row, flex-wrap: nowrap\nlabelBox: flex 38%; max-width 38%; column; gap 8px\n            label     Typography subtitle.2 (16/24/500) #24242E\n            sub-label Typography subtitle.3 (14/22/500) #747581   (e.g. \"Confirm Verbal Approval by attaching a file\")\nvalue:    flex 62%; max-width 62%; height 46px; padding 0 12px;\n          display flex; align-items center;\n          border-bottom: 1px solid #CFCFE4\n          (clampedValue → height auto, width 100% for multi-line)\n```\nThe value's **46px** height matches the `medium` input height exactly, so read and edit modes don't shift.\n\nNested tables inside drawers: `border 1px #CFCFE4; radius 12px`, `td padding 12px; border:none`, row dividers `1px #CFCFE4`, first column `width 260px`; tinted rows `#EBEBF4` (`colored`) and `#FBFBFA` (`coloredSubTotal`).\n\n### 4.3 Number & date alignment / formats\n- **Right-aligned numerics**: `rightAlignedNumber { text-align: right; padding-right: 48px }` (`change-orders/styles.tsx`, `spacing(11)`). Note grid money columns are *not* universally right-aligned — it's applied per table.\n- **Currency**: `formatUsd` = `Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD',minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2})`; zero → `'$0.00'` (or `''` with `showZero=false`) (`src/Utils/helpres.ts:18-30`). `formatUsdForView` returns the empty symbol for null/0.\n- **Plain numbers**: `formatNumber` = `toLocaleString('en-US')` (`helpres.ts:13-16`); percentages `formatPercentForView` → `\"{v}%\"` (`helpres.ts:40-41`).\n- **Empty value**: `EMPTY_VALUE_SYMBOL = '—'` (em dash) — `src/Utils/constants.ts:44`. Every `*ForView` helper falls back to it.\n- **Dates** (`src/Utils/time.ts:9-22`): `DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT = 'MM/DD/YYYY'`, `DEFAULT_DATE_TIME_FORMAT = 'MM/DD/YYYY h:mmA'`, plus `'YYYY-MM-DD'` (API), `'MMMM YYYY'`, `'dddd, MM/DD'`, `'MM/DD'`. Default timezone **`America/New_York`** via dayjs `tz.setDefault`. Epoch-millis is the wire format (`epochMilliToDateFormat`).\n\n### 4.4 Iconography\n`iconoir-react ^7.6.0` throughout (no MUI icons except a few legacy `CheckCircle`/`Close`). Size ladder:\n- **22px** — buttons (`large`), icon buttons (medium/small), input adornments, drawer close, select caret, date nav\n- **18px** — sidebar link icons, apps-submenu icons\n- **16px** — `medium`/`small` button icons, chips, status-select caret, collapse arrow, KPI card icon\n- **12px** — grid header sort/edit affordances (`spacing(5)` in `ErnestHeaderCell`)\n- **32px** — app-bar utility icons (AI, bell, avatar)\n\nDefault icon colour is `foreground.quaternary #747581`; on dark sidebar `#DADADD`; interactive/info `#4A89A7`.\n\n### 4.5 Density\n**Compact-but-breathing.** Data surfaces are tight (61px rows, 12px cell padding, 44px headers, 12/500/20 uppercase header text, 2-line cell clamp, 4px between sidebar links); chrome and forms are airier (24px page gutters, 24px card padding, 40px drawer section separation, 46px inputs). Corners are small (8px), shadows are almost invisible (`0 1px 2px .5px rgba(0,0,0,.15)`), and borders do the structural work — `#EBEBF4` for data/hairlines, `#CFCFE4` for containers and form rules. The only saturated colour is the teal-blue `#4A89A7`; everything else is a warm grey ramp on a white canvas with `#FBFBFA` as the second surface.\n\n---\n\n## 5. DASHBOARD — project insights (project home)\n\n`/Users/drhendrix/ernest/ernest-api/spa/src/features/dashboard/project-insights/index.tsx` (route `/mgmt/office/:projectId/dashboard/insights`, first Dashboard sub-link).\n\n**Top block** (`index.tsx:155-177`, `styles.tsx:3-12`) — `padding: 0 24px`, column, `gap: 12px`:\n1. **Control row** `justify-content: space-between` — left `ErnestSwitch size=\"medium\"` labelled *\"Include Approved, but not Executed COs\"* (drives `includeVerbalCO` into the query); right `ErnestButton title=\"Add Action Item\" icon={<Plus/>} size=\"small\" variant=\"text-only\"` opening `CreateProjectActionModal`.\n2. **KPI row** `InsightsPageCards` (`components/InsightsPageCards/index.tsx:163-188`) — outer `Box {display:flex; gap:24px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between}` wrapping a MUI `Grid container spacing={{xs:6}} columns={{xs:12}}` (16px gutters), each item `xs={2}` → **6 per row**, or `xs={4}` → **3 per row** below `1900px` (`index.tsx:27`). Each is a `PercentageCard` inside a shadowless `Paper`. Order and content:\n\n   | # | title | value | percentage |\n   |---|---|---|---|\n   | 1 | Direct Labor Hours | `{usedLaborHours} / {laborHours}` (0 dp) | `used/total × 100` |\n   | 2 | Specialty Material | `formatUsd(spend) / formatUsd(budget)` | spend/budget |\n   | 3 | Commodity Material | same | same |\n   | 4 | Equipment | same | same |\n   | 5 | Travel | same | same |\n   | 6 | General | same | same |\n\n   Percentage renders in `subtitle.1` and flips to `#DB5E58` at **≥ 80%** (`PercentageCard/index.tsx:48-52`); while fetching, value shows `'-'` and a 32px spinner replaces the content.\n\n**Tab block** (`index.tsx:99-114`) — `PageTabsHeader` + `ErnestTabs`, five tabs in declaration order (`index.tsx:35-41`):\n1. **Activity Metrics** — bare `ErnestDataGrid`, **no toolbar**. Two columns: `metricName` (headerName *\"Weekly Metrics\"*, `flex 5`, `maxWidth 300`) and an unnamed value column (`flex 5`, `minWidth 300`). Rows: *Approved* (`\"{n} Reports / {hours} Hours\"` + `pending` pill **\"Missing Today\"** when no report today) · *Off-site* · *Media Uploaded* (`pending` pill **\"No Media\"** at 0) · *Media Comments* (`pending` pill **\"No Comments\"** at 0) · **OTHER** — a section-header *row* (`getRowHeight` → **44**, styled `12/500/20 uppercase #747581` on `#FBFBFA`, `ActivityMetricsTable/styles.tsx:13-23`) · *Submitted Change Orders* (`\"{n} for {formatUsd(fee)}\"`, gets the closing bottom border). All other rows **61px**. Wrapper strips header shadow and `main` border, adds `border-top 1px #EBEBF4` (`styles.tsx:29-39`).\n2. **Phase Budget Table** — `ErnestDataGridWithSearchAndFilter`: search placeholder *\"Search by Phase\"*, one checkbox filter **Budget** (`Over Budget` / `Near Budget` via `InsightsBudgetThresholdType`), front button `ErnestButton variant=\"text-only\" size=\"small\" icon={<Download/>}` *\"Export Budget Table\"* → `json2csv` then a success `ErnestAlert` toast (`PhaseBudgetTable/index.tsx:46-90`). Phase-name cells use a 2-line ellipsis mixin; threshold cells render `ThresholdPill` — `negative` **\"Over Budget\"** when `spent > budget`, `pending` **\"Near Budget\"** at `spent/budget ≥ 0.90`, `hideIcon` (`components/ThresholdPill/index.tsx:7-45`).\n3. **Phase Budget Chart** — ApexCharts horizontal bar, container `padding: 0 24px 0 8px` (30px < xl, 20px < md), explicit `height = 52 × rows + 95` to stop Apex auto-scaling, `Spinner` while fetching, centred `'No data available.'` when empty (`PhaseBudgetChart/index.tsx:15, 37-58`; `styles.tsx:11-25`).\n4. **Labor Burndown** — `LaborBurndownTable`.\n5. **Budget Spend** — `MarginAnalysisTable` (largest module: snapshot form + snapshot table + `ViewProgressSnapshot`).\n\nPage-level instrumentation: per-page and per-tab dwell-time events via `useIdle` + `useLogEventOnPageOnUnmount` + `generateEventName` (`index.tsx:57-97`). So the project home is **controls → 6 KPI tiles → tabbed table/chart workspace**, with no charts above the fold.\n\n---\n\n# TAILWIND TRANSPLANT SPEC\n\n## A. `tailwind.config.ts`\n\n```ts\nimport    success:  { DEFAULT: '#58994E', hover: '#447D3D', soft: '#E7F3E5' },\n        pending:  { DEFAULT: '#DE732C', hover: '#D05E26', soft: '#FBEBDA' }, // == warning\n        negative: { DEFAULT: '#DB5E58', hover: '#C43F39', soft: '#FDF3F3' }, // == error\n        other:    { DEFAULT: '#4A89A7', hover: '#386580', soft: '#F1F7F9' },\n        neutral:  { DEFAULT: '#747581', hover: '#5D5E69', soft: '#EFEFF0' }, // status \"default\"\n        // ── dark sidebar ─────────────────────────────────────────\n        sidebar:  { from: '#131619', to: '#22282E', flyout: '#303438' },\n      },\n\n      backgroundImage: {\n        sidebar: 'linear-gradient(175deg, #131619 0%, #22282E 100%)',\n        'sticky-cell':   'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0) 0%, #FFF 35%)',\n        'sticky-header': 'linear-gradient(to left, #FBFBFA 80%, transparent)',\n      },\n\n      // Ernest's non-linear index scale, exposed as named steps so it can coexist\n      // with Tailwind's default 4px scale. e-4 = 8px = the default radius/gap.\n      spacing: {\n        'e-0': '0px',  'e-1': '2px',  'e-2': '4px',  'e-3': '6px',  'e-4': '8px',\n        'e-5': '12px', 'e-6': '16px', 'e-7': '20px', 'e-8': '24px', 'e-9': '32px',\n        'e-10': '40px','e-11': '48px','e-12': '64px','e-13': '80px',\n        // fixed chrome dimensions\n        'appbar': '64px', 'rail': '72px', 'sidenav': '300px',\n        'drawer': '750px', 'row': '61px', 'thead': '44px',\n        'ctl-lg': '50px', 'ctl-md': '46px', 'ctl-sm': '38px',\n      },\n\n      fontSize: {\n        // [size, { lineHeight, fontWeight }] — letterSpacing is intentionally absent (Ernest defines none)\n        'h1':         ['36px', { lineHeight: '44px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'h1-semi':    ['36px', { lineHeight: '44px', fontWeight: '600' }],\n        'h2':         ['26px', { lineHeight: '34px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'h3':         ['24px', { lineHeight: '32px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'h4':         ['20px', { lineHeight: '28px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'subtitle-1': ['18px', { lineHeight: '26px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'subtitle-2': ['16px', { lineHeight: '24px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'subtitle-3': ['14px', { lineHeight: '22px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'subtitle-4': ['12px', { lineHeight: '20px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'subtitle-5': ['10px', { lineHeight: '14px', fontWeight: '500' }], // fixes Ernest's undefined LH\n        'body-1':     ['16px', { lineHeight: '24px', fontWeight: '400' }],\n        'body-2':     ['14px', { lineHeight: '22px', fontWeight: '400' }], // ← default body / grid cell\n        'body-3':     ['12px', { lineHeight: '20px', fontWeight: '400' }],\n        'body-4':     ['10px', { lineHeight: '12px', fontWeight: '400' }],\n        'caption-1':  ['16px', { lineHeight: '24px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'caption-2':  ['14px', { lineHeight: '22px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'caption-3':  ['12px', { lineHeight: '20px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'caption-4':  ['10px', { lineHeight: '12px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'button-1':   ['18px', { lineHeight: '26px', fontWeight: '600' }],\n        'button-2':   ['16px', { lineHeight: '24px', fontWeight: '600' }],\n        'button-3':   ['14px', { lineHeight: '22px', fontWeight: '600' }], // ← default button\n        'overline':   ['10px', { lineHeight: '12px', fontWeight: '500' }],\n        'thead':      ['12px', { lineHeight: '20px', fontWeight: '500' }], // uppercase grid header\n      },\n\n      borderRadius: {\n        'e-xs': '2px',   // status dot, small pill, tooltip\n        'e-sm': '4px',   // chip, small icon button, counter badge\n        'e-md': '6px',   // segment tab, action popover, toast\n        'e-lg': '8px',   // DEFAULT: buttons, inputs, cards, menus, pills\n        'e-xl': '12px',  // nested drawer tables, confirm modal\n        'e-pill': '80px',\n      },\n\n      boxShadow: {\n        'e-card':   '0px 1px 2px 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)', // cards, menus, popovers, active segment\n        'e-drawer': '-5px 0px 5px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',\n        'e-toggle': '0px 20px 24px -4px rgba(36,36,46,0.08)',\n        'e-actions':'0px 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)',\n        'e-focus':  '0px 0px 0px 4px #DCEAEF',            // form focus ring\n      },\n\n      screens: { sm: '480px', md: '768px', lg: '1024px', xl: '1440px', '3xl': '1900px' },\n\n      transitionTimingFunction: { 'e-standard': 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' },\n      transitionDuration: { 'e-fast': '150ms', 'e-nav': '300ms', 'e-fade': '200ms' },\n    },\n  },\n} satisfies Config;\n```\n\nIf you prefer a hard cut over coexistence, replace `spacing` wholesale with `{0:'0px',1:'2px',2:'4px',3:'6px',4:'8px',5:'12px',6:'16px',7:'20px',8:'24px',9:'32px',10:'40px',11:'48px',12:'64px',13:'80px'}` — that is literally Ernest's scale, but it silently changes the meaning of every existing `p-4`/`gap-6` in BuildPanda. Prefer the `e-*` aliases.\n\n## B. Class recipes per BuildPanda surface\n\n**Shell**\n```html\n<div class=\"grid h-screen grid-cols-[72px_1fr] grid-rows-[64px_1fr]\n            [grid-template-areas:'nav_header''nav_content']\n            transition-[grid-template-columns] duration-e-nav ease-in-out\n            data-[nav=open]:grid-cols-[300px_1fr]\">\n```\n\n**1. Sidebar** (dark, 72 ↔ 300, group headings, 48px items, 18px icons)\n```html\n<!-- container -->\n<nav class=\"[grid-area:nav] z-20 grid grid-rows-[auto_1fr_auto] max-h-screen\n            w-rail bg-sidebar transition-[width] duration-e-nav ease-in-out\n            group-data-[nav=open]:w-sidenav relative\">\n\n  <!-- header: launcher + logo -->\n  <div class=\"flex items-center gap-e-6 pt-e-6 px-e-8 pb-e-8\">\n    <button class=\"rounded-e-sm text-ink-disabled hover:text-ink-inverted\"><AppsIcon class=\"size-[22px]\"/></button>\n    <span class=\"opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-e-fade group-data-[nav=open]:opacity-100\"><Logo/></span>\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- collapse toggle -->\n  <button class=\"absolute right-0 top-e-7 -mr-[15px] flex size-e-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full\">\n    <span class=\"flex size-e-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#3B3C3F] text-ink-inverted\n                 shadow-e-toggle rotate-180 transition-transform duration-500 ease-in-out\n                 group-data-[nav=open]:rotate-0\"><ChevronLeft class=\"size-4 stroke-[2.5]\"/></span>\n  </button>\n\n  <!-- project switcher -->\n  <div class=\"bg-white/10 px-e-8 py-e-2 pr-e-7 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-e-fade\n              hover:bg-white/30 group-data-[nav=open]:opacity-100\">…</div>\n\n  <!-- group heading -->\n  <div class=\"px-e-6 pl-e-8 pt-e-6 pb-e-4 text-subtitle-3 uppercase text-ink-muted\n              opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-e-fade group-data-[nav=open]:opacity-100\">Office Management</div>\n\n  <!-- link list -->\n  <div class=\"flex flex-col gap-e-2 overflow-auto\">\n    <!-- item: 12px/24px padding + 24px row = 48px -->\n    <a class=\"flex cursor-pointer flex-col gap-e-2 px-e-8 py-e-5\n              transition-colors duration-e-fast ease-e-standard\n              hover:bg-white/10 aria-[current]:bg-white/10\">\n      <span class=\"flex h-6 flex-nowrap items-center gap-e-4\">\n        <Icon class=\"size-[18px] text-ink-disabled\"/>\n        <span class=\"whitespace-nowrap text-body-1 text-ink-inverted opacity-0\n                     transition-opacity duration-e-fade group-data-[nav=open]:opacity-100\">Finance</span>\n      </span>\n      <!-- sub-links (expanded + active parent only) -->\n      <span class=\"flex flex-col gap-e-2 pl-[28px]\">\n        <a class=\"cursor-pointer rounded-e-lg px-e-6 py-e-3 text-body-1 text-ink-inverted\n                  transition-colors duration-e-fast ease-e-standard\n                  hover:bg-white/30 aria-[current]:bg-white/30\">Change Orders</a>\n      </span>\n    </a>\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- footer user -->\n  <div class=\"cursor-pointer pt-e-5 pb-e-8 hover:bg-white/10\">\n    <div class=\"flex flex-nowrap items-center gap-e-5 pl-[14px] pr-e-6 pt-e-5 transition-[padding]\n                duration-e-fade group-data-[nav=open]:pl-e-8\">\n      <Avatar class=\"size-e-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border-[0.5px] border-black\"/>\n      <div class=\"max-w-[145px] opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-e-fade group-data-[nav=open]:opacity-100\">\n        <p class=\"truncate text-subtitle-3 text-ink-inverted\">Jane Doe</p>\n        <p class=\"truncate text-body-2 text-ink-muted\">jane@x.com</p>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</nav>\n<!-- collapsed hover fly-out -->\n<div class=\"fixed left-rail z-[599] w-[250px] rounded-r-e-xl bg-sidebar-flyout p-e-5 shadow-e-card\">…</div>\n```\n\n**2. Page header (app bar + title + tabs)**\n```html\n<!-- app bar, 64px -->\n<header class=\"[grid-area:header] z-10 flex items-center justify-between\n               border-b border-line-hair bg-surface-alt px-e-8 py-e-6\">\n  <h1 class=\"text-h3 text-ink\">Change Orders</h1>\n  <div class=\"ml-auto flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-e-6\">…32px icons…</div>\n</header>\n\n<!-- content column -->\n<main class=\"[grid-area:content] flex min-h-0 flex-col gap-e-6 overflow-y-auto bg-surface pt-e-8\">\n  <!-- breadcrumb bar -->\n  <nav class=\"px-e-8 text-body-2 text-ink\">\n    <a class=\"max-w-[256px] truncate hover:text-ink-hover hover:underline\">Projects</a>\n    <span class=\"mx-e-2 text-ink\">/</span><span class=\"truncate\">Acme Tower</span>\n  </nav>\n\n  <!-- PageTabsHeader: outer gutter, inner rule -->\n  <div class=\"px-e-8\">\n    <div class=\"flex w-full items-center justify-between border-b border-line bg-surface\">\n      …tabs…  …right actions…\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</main>\n```\n\n**3. Toolbar** (search + filter left, buttons right, 32px between clusters)\n```html\n<div class=\"flex flex-nowrap gap-e-9 bg-surface px-e-8\">\n  <div class=\"flex flex-wrap items-start gap-e-6\">\n    <div class=\"w-[300px] min-w-[300px]\">…search (38px)…</div>\n    <div class=\"flex w-fit gap-e-5\">…filter buttons / chips…</div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"flex w-fit flex-[0_0_auto] items-start gap-e-5\">…buttons…</div>\n</div>\n```\nSearch input: `h-ctl-sm w-full rounded-e-lg border border-line bg-surface pl-e-4 pr-e-5 text-body-2 text-ink placeholder:text-ink-muted hover:border-line-hover focus:border-primary focus:shadow-e-focus focus:outline-none`\nFilter button: `flex h-ctl-sm items-center gap-e-2 rounded-e-lg border border-line bg-surface px-e-5 py-e-4 text-body-2 text-ink hover:bg-primary-soft hover:border-primary hover:text-primary aria-expanded:bg-primary-soft aria-expanded:border-primary aria-expanded:text-primary focus-visible:shadow-e-focus focus-visible:border-primary focus-visible:outline-none` + badge `flex size-[18px] items-center justify-center rounded-e-sm bg-primary text-overline text-white`\n\n**4. KPI card**\n```html\n<div class=\"flex flex-1 gap-e-5 rounded-e-lg border border-line-hair bg-surface p-e-8\n            shadow-e-card max-md:px-e-6 max-md:py-e-5\">\n  <div class=\"flex size-e-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface-info\">\n    <Icon class=\"size-e-6 text-primary\"/>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"flex flex-col gap-e-2\">\n    <p class=\"text-caption-2 text-ink-muted\">Approved CO</p>\n    <div class=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-e-4\">\n      <p class=\"min-w-max flex-[1_0_auto] text-h2 text-ink\">$1,240,500.00</p>\n      <p class=\"min-w-max text-caption-1 text-ink-muted\">of $1.5M</p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n<!-- percentage variant (shadowless, 12px pad, 76px floor) -->\n<div class=\"flex min-h-[76px] flex-1 items-start gap-e-5 rounded-e-lg border border-line-hair bg-surface p-e-5\">\n  <p class=\"text-subtitle-1 text-ink data-[over]:text-negative\">82%</p>\n  <div class=\"flex flex-col gap-e-2\">\n    <p class=\"text-caption-2 text-ink\">Specialty Material</p>\n    <p class=\"text-caption-3 text-ink-muted\">$41,000.00 / $50,000.00</p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n<!-- KPI row -->\n<div class=\"flex flex-nowrap gap-e-6 px-e-8\"> … </div>\n<!-- insights KPI grid: 6-up, 3-up under 1900 -->\n<div class=\"grid grid-cols-3 gap-e-6 px-e-8 3xl:grid-cols-6\"> … </div>\n```\n\n**5. Table**\n```html\n<div class=\"flex flex-[1_0_300px] flex-col\">\n  <table class=\"w-full border-separate border-spacing-0 border-t border-line-hair\n                bg-surface font-sans text-body-2 text-ink\">\n    <thead>\n      <tr class=\"h-thead\">\n        <th class=\"whitespace-nowrap bg-surface-alt px-e-5 py-0 text-left text-thead\n                   uppercase text-ink-muted border-b border-line-hair first:pl-e-8 last:pr-e-8\">\n          <span class=\"inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-e-2\">Phase\n            <SortIcon class=\"size-e-5 rounded-e-xs p-[2px] text-ink-muted transition-transform duration-300\n                             hover:bg-black/5 data-[asc]:rotate-180\"/></span>\n        </th>\n      </tr>\n    </thead>\n    <tbody>\n      <!-- no zebra; 61px rows; hover = #FBFBFA -->\n      <tr class=\"group h-row bg-surface\">\n        <td class=\"border-b border-line-hair px-e-5 py-0 align-middle\n                   first:pl-e-8 last:pr-e-8 group-hover:bg-surface-alt\">\n          <span class=\"line-clamp-2 whitespace-break-spaces\">Level 3 — Rough-in</span>\n        </td>\n        <!-- right-aligned money -->\n        <td class=\"border-b border-line-hair px-e-5 pr-e-11 text-right tabular-nums\n                   group-hover:bg-surface-alt\">$1,240,500.00</td>\n        <!-- sticky first column -->\n        <td class=\"sticky left-0 z-10 border-r border-line-hair bg-surface pl-e-8 pr-e-5\n                   group-hover:bg-surface-alt\">…</td>\n        <!-- sticky last column with fade -->\n        <td class=\"sticky right-0 z-10 bg-sticky-cell pr-e-8\">…actions…</td>\n      </tr>\n      <!-- in-table section header row -->\n      <tr class=\"h-thead bg-surface-alt\">\n        <td colspan=\"2\" class=\"px-e-5 pl-e-8 text-thead uppercase text-ink-muted\">Other</td>\n      </tr>\n    </tbody>\n  </table>\n\n  <!-- footer / pagination -->\n  <div class=\"flex h-ctl-sm w-full items-center justify-between p-e-6\">\n    <span class=\"text-caption-2 text-ink\">1–25 of 138 items</span>\n    <div class=\"flex items-center gap-e-4\">\n      <button class=\"… btn-secondary-grey btn-sm\">Previous</button>\n      <button class=\"… btn-secondary-grey btn-sm\">Next</button>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- empty state (upgrade on Ernest: it has none) -->\n  <div class=\"mx-e-8 flex flex-col items-center gap-e-4 rounded-e-lg border border-line\n              bg-surface-alt px-e-6 py-e-11 text-center\">\n    <Icon class=\"size-e-9 text-ink-disabled\"/>\n    <p class=\"text-subtitle-2 text-ink\">No data</p>\n    <p class=\"text-body-2 text-ink-muted\">Nothing matches these filters yet.</p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n```\nSticky-last header cell uses `bg-sticky-header` instead of `bg-sticky-cell`.\n\n**6. Drawer (750px)**\n```html\n<aside class=\"fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 flex w-drawer max-w-full flex-col\n              border border-[#D9D9D9] bg-surface shadow-e-drawer md:max-md:w-full\">\n  <!-- header -->\n  <div class=\"flex flex-nowrap items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-e-9 py-e-8\">\n    <h2 class=\"mr-auto truncate whitespace-nowrap text-h3 text-ink\">Change Order #124</h2>\n    <div class=\"flex w-auto flex-nowrap items-center gap-e-2\">…chip · +…</div>\n    <button class=\"rounded-e-sm p-e-2 text-ink hover:bg-black/5\"><X class=\"size-[22px]\"/></button>\n  </div>\n  <!-- body -->\n  <div class=\"flex flex-1 flex-col flex-nowrap gap-e-10 overflow-y-auto px-e-9 pt-e-10 pb-e-9\">\n    <section class=\"flex flex-col gap-e-8 border-b border-line pb-e-10 last:border-0 last:pb-0\">\n      <h3 class=\"text-h3 text-ink\">General Information</h3>\n      <!-- label/value pair, 38/62 -->\n      <div class=\"flex flex-nowrap\">\n        <div class=\"flex basis-[38%] flex-col flex-nowrap gap-e-4 pr-e-4\">\n          <p class=\"text-subtitle-2 text-ink\">Additional file</p>\n          <p class=\"max-w-[200px] text-subtitle-3 text-ink-muted\">Confirm Verbal Approval by attaching a file</p>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"flex h-ctl-md basis-[62%] items-center border-b border-line px-e-5\">…value / field…</div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  </div>\n  <!-- footer -->\n  <div class=\"ml-auto mt-auto flex w-fit flex-nowrap gap-e-6 px-e-9 pb-e-9 pt-e-8\">\n    <button class=\"btn-text\">Cancel</button><button class=\"btn-primary\">Save</button>\n  </div>\n</aside>\n```\n\n**7. Buttons**\n```html\n<!-- base -->\nclass=\"inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-e-2 rounded-e-lg whitespace-nowrap\n       transition-colors duration-e-fast ease-out normal-case disabled:cursor-not-allowed\"\n<!-- sizes -->\nlg → \"h-ctl-lg min-w-[140px] px-e-8 py-e-5 text-button-1 [&_svg]:size-[22px]\"\nmd → \"h-ctl-md min-w-[96px] px-e-8 py-e-5 text-button-3 [&_svg]:size-4\"\nsm → \"h-ctl-sm px-e-5 py-e-4 text-button-3 [&_svg]:size-4\"\n<!-- variants -->\nprimary         → \"bg-primary text-ink-inverted hover:bg-primary-hover\n                   disabled:border disabled:border-line-disabled disabled:bg-surface-alt disabled:text-ink-disabled disabled:bg-none\"\nsecondary-color → \"border border-line bg-surface text-ink\n                   hover:border-primary hover:bg-primary-soft hover:text-primary\n                   disabled:border-line-disabled disabled:bg-surface-alt disabled:text-ink-disabled\"\nsecondary-grey  → \"border border-line-hair bg-surface-alt text-ink hover:bg-black/5\n                   disabled:border-line-disabled disabled:bg-surface disabled:text-ink-disabled\"\ntext            → \"bg-transparent text-primary hover:bg-black/5 disabled:text-ink-disabled\"\nnegative        → \"bg-transparent text-negative hover:bg-black/5 disabled:text-ink-disabled\"\n<!-- icon button -->\nmd → \"grid place-items-center rounded-e-lg p-e-4 [&_svg]:size-[22px]\"\nsm → \"grid place-items-center rounded-e-sm p-e-2 [&_svg]:size-[22px]\"\nxs → \"grid place-items-center rounded-e-sm p-e-2 [&_svg]:size-4\"\n   filled:  \"bg-primary text-ink-inverted hover:bg-primary-hover\"\n   ghost:   \"text-ink-muted hover:bg-black/5 hover:text-ink\"\n   disabled:\"bg-surface-alt text-ink-disabled cursor-not-allowed\"\n```\n\n**8. Badge / status pill**\n```html\n<!-- medium -->\n<span class=\"inline-flex h-fit w-fit min-w-[64px] items-center justify-start gap-e-3\n             rounded-e-lg px-e-4 py-e-2 text-caption-2\">\n  <i class=\"size-[6px] shrink-0 rounded-e-xs bg-current\"></i>\n  <span class=\"truncate\">Approved</span>\n</span>\n<!-- small -->\nclass=\"… min-w-0 gap-e-1 rounded-e-xs p-e-1 text-caption-4 [&>i]:size-[4px]\"\n<!-- colour per type (bg + text; dot inherits via bg-current) -->\nsuccess  → \"bg-success-soft  text-success\"\npending  → \"bg-pending-soft  text-pending\"\nnegative → \"bg-negative-soft text-negative\"\nother    → \"bg-other-soft    text-other\"\ndefault  → \"bg-neutral-soft  text-neutral\"\n<!-- interactive StatusSelect: pill inverts on hover -->\nclass=\"… cursor-pointer transition-[background-color,color] duration-200 ease-in-out\n       hover:bg-success hover:text-white [&:hover_*]:text-white\"\nmenu → \"w-[275px] rounded-e-lg border border-line bg-surface py-e-2 shadow-e-card\n        [&_li]:px-e-4 [&_li]:py-e-4 [&_li:hover]:bg-black/5\"\n<!-- chip (metadata, not status) -->\nclass=\"inline-flex w-fit flex-nowrap items-center gap-e-2 rounded-e-sm border px-e-4 py-e-1\n       text-caption-2 transition-colors duration-300 ease-e-standard [&_svg]:size-4\"\n  default → \"border-line-disabled bg-surface-alt text-ink\"\n  blue    → \"border-primary-soft bg-primary-soft text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-ink-inverted\"\n```\n\n**9. disabled:border-line-disabled disabled:bg-surface-alt disabled:text-ink-disabled\n                  aria-[invalid]:border-negative aria-[invalid]:shadow-none\n
